events.title: Davis-Putnam gives universal exact descent but Galil proves exponential state generation for a hard family under every elimination order
formal_statement: Davis-Putnam elimination DP_x(F) exactly represents exists x F and therefore preserves satisfiability.
The rank mu_DP=#remaining variables decreases by exactly one at every elimination stage for every CNF.
A one-step bucket with m positive-x and m negative-x clauses can create m^2 distinct resolvents, so work polynomial in current state does not imply polynomial work in original input.
Zvi Galil 1977 constructs infinitely many contradictory CNFs for which Davis-Putnam generates 2^(c n) distinct clauses for any variable-elimination order.
events.external_source: Zvi Galil, On the complexity of regular resolution and the Davis-Putnam procedure, Theoretical Computer Science 4 (1977), 23-46.
events.claim_ceiling: Galil closes the exact Davis-Putnam procedure, not unrestricted ER/B2 and not P vs NP.

events.title: Naive quantifier-free B2 Shannon projection preserves exact descent but retains exponential representation growth
formal_statement: Exact projection satisfies exists x C(x,y)=C(0,y) OR C(1,y).
Frozen B2 implements the OR with a De-Morgan AND gate over signed outputs.
A no-sharing constructor that copies both restricted circuits obeys S_(k+1)=2 S_k+1, hence S_k=2^k(S_0+1)-1.
This is an algorithm-specific exponential recurrence, not a lower bound on minimum B2 circuit size of the projected function.
Keeping an existential quantifier wrapper compact does not solve the problem unless quantifier elimination/evaluation is also polynomial.

provider_receipt.workflow: Validate Akinator U1H B2 Shannon Projection

events.claim_ceiling: No lower bound on minimum unrestricted B2 projection size is proved. Smart proof-carrying sharing/compression remains open.

active_front.name: U1_I_PROOF_CARRYING_B2_PROJECTION_COMPRESSION
active_front.question: Can every exact existential projection of a polynomial-size frozen-B2 state be transformed into a polynomial-size quantifier-free B2 state in deterministic polynomial total work, using only proof-carrying sharing/compression and preserving one-variable-per-stage descent?
active_front.closure_if_proved: Repeated exact projection would decide SAT in polynomial time, hence P=NP.
